scenes.title: Starter Story — Video-as-Code Pipeline (make.pictures)
scenes.speaker: Narrator (make.pictures)
scenes.text: Instead of keyframing by hand, describe your vision to an AI agent! It generates ElevenLabs voiceovers, selects a visual kit from code, and renders silky sixty frames per second animation! Create with make dot pictures!

scenes.title: Intro — Aether Engine
scenes.text: Meet Aether Engine. A modern application architecture natively built for real-time AI agents.

scenes.title: UI Showcase — Production Telemetry
scenes.text: Every user interaction triggers a background agent pipeline with sub-fifty millisecond latency.

scenes.title: Architecture & Data Flow Telemetry
scenes.text: The web client sends structured request context directly to the AI Agent API. After ultra-fast inference, insights are durably persisted in PostgreSQL.

scenes.title: Outro — Production Ready
scenes.text: Ship faster and scale without compromise. Aether Engine — ready for production.

scenes.title: Isometric 3D Dialogue — Line 1 (Alex)
scenes.speaker: Alex
scenes.text: Have you seen how long it takes to edit product videos frame by frame?

scenes.title: Isometric 3D Dialogue — Line 2 (Max)
scenes.speaker: Max
scenes.text: That is why we generate this entire three-dimensional studio directly from code.

scenes.title: Isometric 3D Dialogue — Line 3 (Alex)
scenes.speaker: Alex
scenes.text: One TypeScript project, two voices, and smooth animation at sixty frames per second!
